ticks.note: A cup stands under the spout in tick 1. `Ready`'s transition is immediate, so both machines start filling it at once (`fills` = 1). The initial entry is never deferred.

The cup is full. Nobody has taken it away yet, so `cup` is still true in this tick. `FillerNormal`: `go to Ready` enters `Ready`, whose immediate transition sees `cup` and starts filling the full cup again (2). `FillerDeferred`: `go to Ready deferred` arrives in `Ready` quietly, so its immediate transition waits (1).
The cup has been taken away. `FillerDeferred`'s `Ready` now looks at `cup`, finds no cup, and waits. `FillerNormal` is `Filling` with nothing under the spout.
A new cup. `FillerDeferred` starts filling it (2). `FillerNormal` is still in `Filling` and counts nothing.
The second cup is full and still there. `FillerNormal` starts on it again (3); `FillerDeferred` waits a tick (2).
The cup is gone. Two cups: `FillerDeferred` counted two fills, `FillerNormal` three.
